versions.content: If a controller mode referenced by ControllerId enters state CAN_CS_STOPPED , then CanIf shall inform corresponding upper layer modules about failed transmission by calling <User_TxConfirmation>(id, E_NOT_OK) for every outstanding TxConfirmation assigned to that CAN Controller. If CanIfPublicTx- ConfirmPollingSupport is enabled, CanIf shall also clear the information about a TxConfirmation (see [SWS_CANIF_00740]).
